## CMsoft Import for Step7

The Step7 V5.7 project mirror (AWL / STL sources of the blocks, symbol tables). Full instructions, applied
automatically:

- [instructions/step7-import.instructions.md](instructions/step7-import.instructions.md) — the AWL / STL source
  format, block structure, editing and re-import through SIMATIC Manager, the rules;
- [instructions/step7-import-cli.instructions.md](instructions/step7-import-cli.instructions.md) — the CLI bridge
  (for scripts in `Tools/`).

The library blocks of the project are described in `.github/LibraryDescription.md`; *Import All* keeps the list of
the project's blocks below up to date.
